meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 给选定的 NanoClaw agent 群组注册 Tavily 远程 MCP 服务,装上后这些群组多出 mcp__tavily__tavily_search 和 mcp__tavily__tavily_extract 两个工具,无需 API key(走 Tavily 的 IP 配额)。Crawl、Map、Research 会被过滤掉。
howto.when: 当你想给 agent 群组装免 API key 的 Tavily 网页搜索或 URL 提取,或需要结构化提取时触发。注册与重启命令受审批限制,在容器内执行会先返回 approval-pending。

say.text: 列出所有群组,告诉我哪些能装 Tavily
给 group-x 装上 Tavily 搜索和提取,然后重启它

howto.what_en: Registers Tavily's remote MCP server for selected NanoClaw agent groups, adding mcp__tavily__tavily_search and mcp__tavily__tavily_extract with no API key (Tavily's IP-based allowance). Crawl, Map and Research are filtered out.
howto.when_en: Use when you want keyless Tavily web search or URL extraction for agent groups, or structured extraction. Registration and restart commands are approval-gated; run inside a container they return approval-pending first.

say_en.text: List all groups and tell me which ones can get Tavily
Install Tavily search and extract on group-x, then restart it
Run one tavily_search with max_results 1 and report if it succeeds
